bio: The tree shows Patrick Heffernan 1763-1871 (Ireland flag image) as father of 'Thomas Heffernan 1791'. A 108-year life means at least one date is wrong. In Dwyer's Heffernans of Slieveardagh, Patrick and Catherine Neagle are parents of Thomas 'of Lanespark' (Branch 1, bapt. 1791, m. Catherine Shelly 1831), not of John's Thomas 'of Mardyke'. Dwyer found no proven link between the two families. Remove from Andrew's line.
sources: Johnny Meier's Ancestry tree (screenshots IMG_7791-7840 in John's Google Drive), transcribed in research/tree_transcription.md and Ancestry tree screenshots (section 2.2.2)

Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
